Fixes bug B6276846a03: recover_auto.decisions drops a present-but-False row 'adopted': bool(r.get('adopted') or adopted_items.get(r['item'])) falls through to the fallback True, contradicting the docstring 'a row's own adopted wins where both exist'. A row measured as not-adopted is refused auto-resume.

Write the regression test first and watch it FAIL on the unfixed code; then `ddflow complete fix-B6276846a03 --regression-test <test>` closes the bug with the task (or `ddflow bug fixed B6276846a03 --regression-test <test>` first).
data.title: Fix bug B6276846a03: lanes recover_auto decisions: a False row adopted does not win over adopted_items fallback
